title: 大语言模型中词汇性对表示的持久影响
summary: 研究揭示LLM表示受词汇重叠影响大于语义内容，词汇影响贯穿模型深度，存在中间深度区域语义和词汇信号同时退化，影响下游任务如摘要和模型编辑。
summary_en: Study shows LLM representations are more influenced by lexical overlap than semantic content, with lexical effects persisting across model depth and a mid-depth region where both signals degrade, impacting downstream tasks like summarization and model editing.
